policies.name: EOS Development Mode External Write Barrier
policies.description: During EOS Control Plane self-development, writing to external target projects is forbidden.
policies.reason: External write attempt detected during EOS Development Mode.

policies.name: Implementation Authorization Check
policies.description: External writes require a verified IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORIZED status.
policies.reason: Target project lacks explicit Product Owner Implementation Authorization.

policies.name: Production Release Gate
policies.description: Production release requires explicit Level 4 Product Owner Sign-off.
policies.reason: Production release requires human Product Owner sign-off.

policies.name: Authorized Scope Write
policies.description: Writing within authorized paths under an active IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORIZED record.
policies.reason: Action is within explicitly authorized implementation scope.
